feature: design as the first stage of the hexa loop
description: Design becomes the loop's optional first stage. A review records the draft bytes it read. Only a reviewed, committed draft becomes a proposed ADR that cites it. hexa go, hexa hey and the loop guidance know the design verbs. hexa drift --since checks only the documents a change touched.

accepted.by: gary (run by Claude on gary's instruction)

specs.description: The loop's stages are design, decide, gate, build, harden, done, in that order
specs.given: nothing
specs.then: it returns [Design, Decide, Gate, Build, Harden, Done], in exactly that order, and stage_word gives "design", "decide", "gate", "build", "harden" and "done" for them

specs.description: parse_stage reads the design stage
specs.given: the word "design"
specs.then: it returns Some(LoopStage::Design)

specs.description: parse_stage refuses a word that names no stage
specs.given: the words "", "brainstorm", "review" and "designing"
specs.then: each returns None

specs.description: stage_word and parse_stage round-trip for every stage, and the stage order matches the enum order
specs.given: any stage s in loop_stages()
specs.when: stage_word(s) is parsed back with parse_stage
specs.then: parse_stage(stage_word(s)) == Some(s). loop_stages() is strictly increasing under the LoopStage ordering. No two stages share a word.

specs.description: hexa loop design records a draft inside the project and sets the stage to design
specs.given: a project with a file docs/design/idea.md and a loop at any stage
specs.then: the loop records docs/design/idea.md as its draft, its stage reads `design`, and the command exits successfully

specs.description: hexa loop design refuses a draft that is not a file inside the project
specs.given: a project with no file ghost.md, a file that exists outside the project, and a file docs/designs/d.md inside it
specs.when: `hexa loop design ghost.md`, `hexa loop design ../outside.md` and `hexa loop design /etc/hosts` run
specs.then: each of the three exits with an error whose message names the path and says it is not a file inside the project, records no draft, and leaves the loop's stage unchanged; `hexa loop design docs/designs/d.md` then succeeds and records that draft

specs.description: Design is optional: a loop with no design recorded starts at decide
specs.given: a fresh loop with no draft recorded
specs.then: it is `decide`, not `design`

specs.description: reviewed_sha reads back the recorded draft hash
specs.given: a report whose text contains the line `Draft sha256: ab12cd34` among other content
specs.then: it returns Some("ab12cd34")

specs.description: reviewed_sha finds nothing in a report with no hash line
specs.given: a report with stage sections but no `Draft sha256:` line
specs.then: it returns None

specs.description: review_covers accepts a report with the matching hash and sections for stages 5 to 8
specs.given: a report with `Draft sha256: H` and a section for each of stages 5, 6, 7 and 8
specs.when: review_covers(report, "H") is called, and reviewed_stages(report) is called
specs.then: review_covers returns Ok(()), and reviewed_stages returns [ZoomOut, Comprehension, Critic, IntermediateZoomOut] in report order

specs.description: review_covers refuses a report recorded against a different hash
specs.given: a report with `Draft sha256: H1` and sections for stages 5 to 8
specs.then: it returns Err, and the message says the hash differs

specs.description: review_covers refuses a report with no hash
specs.given: a report with sections for stages 5 to 8 and no `Draft sha256:` line
specs.then: it returns Err, and the message says the hash is missing

specs.description: review_covers names the missing stage numbers
specs.given: a report with `Draft sha256: H` and sections for stages 5 and 7 only
specs.then: it returns Err, and the message names stages 6 and 8

specs.description: A stage-9-only report does not cover a draft
specs.given: a report with `Draft sha256: H` and a section for stage 9 only
specs.then: it returns Err naming stages 5, 6, 7 and 8

specs.description: review_covers is Ok exactly when the hash matches and stages 5 to 8 are all present
specs.given: any report and any draft_sha
specs.then: it returns Ok if and only if reviewed_sha(report) == Some(draft_sha) and reviewed_stages(report) contains each of stages 5, 6, 7 and 8. An extra stage 9 section never turns Ok into Err.

specs.description: hexa design review records the hash of the draft bytes it read
specs.given: a draft file whose bytes hash, under sha256, to H
specs.then: the report contains the line `Draft sha256: H`

specs.description: A reviewed, committed draft becomes a proposed ADR that cites it
specs.given: a draft that git tracks with no uncommitted changes, and a report in the artifact directory that passes review_covers against the draft's current sha256
specs.then: it writes exactly one new file, docs/adrs/ADR-<next id>-<slug>.md, containing `**Status:** Proposed`, numbered decisions under `## Decision`, and the line `**Design:** <draft>`. The loop records that ADR and its stage is `decide`. No spec is written, and the ADR is not accepted.

specs.description: hexa design adr refuses a draft with uncommitted changes
specs.given: a covered draft that has uncommitted changes
specs.then: it exits with an error, writes nothing under docs/adrs/, and leaves the loop unchanged

specs.description: hexa design adr refuses a draft that git does not track
specs.given: an untracked draft
specs.then: it exits with an error whose message says the draft is not tracked by git, and writes no ADR

specs.description: A draft revised after its review must be reviewed again
specs.given: a committed draft whose only review report records the sha256 of an earlier revision, as after `hexa design resolve`
specs.then: it exits with an error saying no review covers the draft's current bytes, writes no ADR, and makes no completion

specs.description: No other hexa design command writes under docs/adrs/
specs.given: a project whose docs/adrs/ holds a known set of files
specs.then: docs/adrs/ holds exactly the same files with the same bytes afterwards

specs.description: An ADR whose Design line resolves passes the doctor
specs.given: an ADR with `**Design:** docs/design/idea.md`, where that file exists in the project
specs.then: it reports no error for that ADR's design line; once docs/design/idea.md is deleted, the same run reports one error naming that ADR and that path

specs.description: hexa adr doctor reports a Design line that does not resolve
specs.given: an ADR with `**Design:** docs/design/gone.md`, where no such file exists
specs.then: it reports an error naming that ADR and the path docs/design/gone.md

specs.description: An ADR with no Design line is not an error
specs.given: an otherwise valid ADR with no `**Design:**` line, and in the same ledger an ADR whose `**Design:**` line names a file that does not exist
specs.then: it reports an error for the second ADR's design line and no error about the first, which has no design

specs.description: Each design state maps to its next action
specs.given: draft d with sha H in four states: (a) no draft recorded; (b) no report covers H; (c) a report covers H and committed is false; (d) a report covers H and committed is true
specs.then: it returns (a) Nothing, (b) Review(d), (c) Commit(d) and (d) ToAdr(d)

specs.description: A review of an earlier revision does not advance past Review, even when the draft is committed
specs.given: a DesignState with draft d, draft_sha256 H2, committed true, and a single review that records H1 and has sections for stages 5 to 8
specs.then: it returns Review(d), not ToAdr(d)

specs.description: hexa go prints no design suggestion when no draft is recorded
specs.given: a loop with no draft recorded
specs.then: its output contains no `hexa design review`, `hexa design adr` or `git commit` suggestion; after `hexa loop design <draft>` records an existing, unreviewed draft, `hexa go` prints `hexa design review <draft>`

specs.description: hexa go prints the verb that matches the next action
specs.given: recorded draft d in the Review, Commit and ToAdr states in turn
specs.then: it prints `hexa design review d`, then `git commit d`, then `hexa design adr d`

specs.description: The next action follows from coverage and commit state for every state
specs.given: any DesignState
specs.then: It returns Nothing if and only if draft is None. Otherwise it carries the draft path. It returns Review exactly when no review passes review_covers against draft_sha256 (or draft_sha256 is None). It returns Commit exactly when one does and committed is false, and ToAdr exactly when one does and committed is true.

specs.description: docs_touched returns changed documents and documents that name changed paths, in docs order
specs.given: docs [("a.md", ["src/x.rs"]), ("b.md", ["src/y.rs"]), ("c.md", [])] and changed ["c.md", "src/x.rs"]
specs.then: it returns ["a.md", "c.md"]

specs.description: docs_touched returns nothing for a change that touches no document
specs.given: docs [("a.md", ["src/x.rs"])] and changed ["src/z.rs"]
specs.then: it returns an empty list

specs.description: hexa drift --since makes no completion when nothing is touched
specs.given: a ref whose diff touches no document and no path any document names
specs.then: the report holds the line `No document touched since <ref>`, and no completion is made

specs.description: hexa drift --since runs one goldfish per touched document and no others
specs.given: three documents, of which exactly two name paths changed since the ref
specs.then: exactly two completions are made, one per touched document, and the untouched document is not checked

specs.description: Without --since, drift checks every document
specs.given: three documents
specs.then: all three documents are checked

specs.description: docs_touched is exactly the ordered, deduplicated set of documents changed or naming a change
specs.given: any docs list and any changed list
specs.then: Each output element is a document from docs that is in changed or names a path in changed. Every such document appears, once, in the order of its first appearance in docs. With an empty changed list, the output is empty.

specs.description: A brainstorm request routes to design brainstorm with the idea, behind confirmation
specs.given: the request `brainstorm an offline sync mode`
specs.then: it returns Routed::Hexa with a command that starts `design brainstorm "` and whose quoted idea holds `offline sync mode`, with destructive set to true

specs.description: A design review request with a path routes to design review
specs.given: the request `review the design in docs/design/idea.md`
specs.then: it returns Routed::Hexa with command `design review docs/design/idea.md` and destructive set to false

specs.description: A design review request without a path has no route
specs.given: the request `review my design`
specs.then: it returns Routed::None, while `review my design docs/designs/d.md` routes to `design review docs/designs/d.md`

specs.description: Drift requests route to drift
specs.given: the requests `check for drift` and `do the docs match the code?`
specs.then: each returns Routed::Hexa with command `drift` and destructive set to false

specs.description: Every design or drift route is a command the table lists
specs.given: any request that routes to a command starting with `design` or `drift`
specs.then: it holds `drift`, `design review <path>` and `design brainstorm <idea>` (written with placeholders), and the routed command's words before its argument match one of them

specs.description: The feature-sized prompt hook names design first
specs.given: a feature-sized prompt
specs.when: the prompt hook emits its guidance
specs.then: the guidance contains ``Design (`hexa design brainstorm "<idea>"`, optional) → Decide``, with Design before Decide

specs.description: The skill and CLAUDE.md cover the design verbs and drift --since
specs.given: the /hexa-workflow skill and hexa's CLAUDE.md
specs.then: The skill has a section before Decide naming `hexa design brainstorm`, `draft`, `review`, `resolve` and `adr`, and its ship step runs `hexa drift --since <base>`. CLAUDE.md's pipeline has a step 0, Design, naming the same verbs.

specs.description: The guidance no longer starts at Decide
specs.given: the feature-sized prompt hook's guidance and the /hexa-workflow skill
specs.then: neither presents Decide as the first step: in each, design appears before Decide
